user.title: Sign in to Alfred Smart
user.description: Use the same email and password as in the Alfred app.

data_description.email: The email of your Alfred Smart account.
data_description.password: Stored in Home Assistant to renew the session by itself.

asset.title: Choose your home
asset.description: This account has access to more than one home. Add the integration again for each of the others.

asset_manual.title: Home code
asset_manual.description: Your home could not be discovered automatically. Open app.alfredsmart.com in a browser, enter your home and, in the developer tools (Network tab), look for a request to `/devices`: the value of `asset_id=` is the code (for example `ABCD1234EFGHI`).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Alfred Smart rejected the password of {email}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Alfred Smart.
error.invalid_asset: Alfred Smart does not recognise this home code.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the list of accesses is read, in minutes. Opening does not depend on it.

open_gateway_unreachable.message: {name} did not open: Alfred's server cannot reach the gateway (HTTP {status}). This is not a Home Assistant problem: use your key and tell the building management.

common_area_gateway_unreachable.message: Common area {name}: Alfred's server cannot reach the gateway (HTTP {status}).

open_unauthorized.message: {name} did not open: Alfred rejected the session. Enter the password of the integration again.

common_area_unauthorized.message: Common area {name}: Alfred rejected the session. Enter the password of the integration again.

open_forbidden.message: {name} did not open: your account is not allowed to use this access (HTTP {status}).

common_area_forbidden.message: Common area {name}: not allowed (HTTP {status}). Is there a booking in force?

open_timeout.message: Alfred did not answer in time when opening {name}. It may have opened anyway: check before trying again.

common_area_timeout.message: Common area {name}: Alfred did not answer in time. The request may have gone through anyway.

common_area_error.message: Common area {name}: Alfred refused the request (HTTP {status}). The slot may be taken or outside opening hours.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded Alfred Smart home with id {entry_id}.

entry_required.message: More than one home is configured: choose which one.

sensor_uuid_required.message: The sensor of common area {area} is unknown: pass `sensor_uuid`.

end_before_start.message: The end must be after the start.

open_common_area.name: Open common area
open_common_area.description: Opens the door of a common area (gym, social club…). It usually needs a booking in force.

config_entry_id.name: Home
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one home is configured.

sensor_uuid.name: Sensor
sensor_uuid.description: UUID of the door reader. When left out, the discovered one is used.

book_common_area.name: Book common area
book_common_area.description: Books a time slot in a common area.

config_entry_id.name: Home
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one home is configured.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the booking (Home Assistant time zone).
